parsed.elsewhere_quote: If $g = 1$, then the new entry $\ell = mn \ge 4$ exceeds $1$. All entries not involved in the move are unchanged, so after the move some entry still exceeds $1$.
parsed.explanation: When gcd(m,n)=1, lcm(m,n)=mn so ℓ=mn/1=mn; writing ℓ=m+n is a misprint (the numeric bound 2·2=4 already reflects the product). The objection's local claim is correct. But the misprint is inert: the same sentence continues "the pair (m,n) is replaced by (1,mn)", from which the type-B conclusions (P unchanged, z increases by exactly 1) follow, and Step 2 independently states ℓ = mn ≥ 4 > 1 to secure "at least one entry > 1 survives". So the termination/exactly-one-survivor ledger item L1.1 is established as argued; only the displayed formula is wrong. Repair: replace m+n by mn.
